Based on the FY2024 10-K income statement data:

Gross margin (dollar amount) = Revenue − Cost of revenue = $245,122 million − $74,114 million = $171,008 million [DOC-1]

Gross margin percentage = $171,008 million / $245,122 million ≈ 69.8% [DOC-1]

Both figures (revenue and cost of revenue) are drawn from the same fiscal year (FY2024, ended June 30, 2024) and the same reporting basis in the 10-K, so this calculation is directly comparable and requires no adjustment.

ANSWER: Gross margin of $171,008 million (approximately 69.8% of revenue) for fiscal year 2024.

Gross margin percentage = $171,008 million / $245,122 million ≈ 69.8% [DOC-1]

Both figures (revenue and cost of revenue) are drawn from the same fiscal year (FY2024, ended June 30, 2024) and the same reporting basis in the 10-K, so this calculation is directly comparable and requires no adjustment.
